What's new in 2.26.0

Bring your own API key, sign yourself up without an invite, and get back in with one tap when you return — plus a full-screen image viewer and a pile of polish.

Bring your own key

  • Use Dax with your own API key. Switch to BYOK in Settings → General, paste a key, and the AI tools run against your account with no server quota in the way. Managed stays the default — switch back whenever you like.
  • Sign yourself up. No invite code needed to get started anymore; onboarding walks you through it.

Coming back to Dax

  • One tap to sign back in. A returning account sees its own avatar, name, and a single Send me a code button — no door picker, no retyping your email. Escape hatches for a code you already have, or a different account entirely.
  • A proper welcome back. The toast greets you by name with your photo, and re-signing in skips onboarding you've already done.

Full-screen images ⌘F

  • Press ⌘F on a generated image to blow it up full screen — pinch to zoom, jump to actual size for a 1:1 pixel look, and see the real dimensions at the bottom.

Profile & account

  • Real profile photos. Pick one properly, and it sticks with you — even through a log out.
  • See what Pro buys you. The upgrade pitch now leads with the reason and lives in a window of its own, with working buttons throughout.

Polish

  • Open Project: press ⇧⇥ to cycle through agents right in the palette.
  • Setup Assistant has a shortcut of its own — ⌃⌥0.
  • Frequent CLIs: kimi --yolo ships as a stock entry.
  • Toasts got a real settings page, and always appear where you expect.
  • Big uploads: File Drop now waits long enough for a 1 GB file, and image uploads no longer time out early.
  • The menu-bar icon parks itself at the far right of the third-party region.
  • Fixed Settings showing "Not signed in" right after you signed in.
  • Fixed a handful of crashes from unsafe unwraps and array access.
  • Signed, notarized, universal (Apple Silicon & Intel), macOS 14+.
